Priya: Proposal: console-driven, quota-aware staged sampling for telemetry previews.
Dmitri: Clarify quota-aware?
Priya: Run a preflight projection against recent traffic and refuse or warn if estimated sampled tokens > tenant_quota * 0.9.
Ava: Projection should be async with confidence bands (low/med/high). Full 30d scans are expensive.
Priya: Agreed, use downsampled stats for quick estimates, full scan only on explicit request.
Dmitri: PII risk: previews must not leak raw content. Two preview modes: synthetic (paraphrased, default) and live-ephemeral (redacted, TTL-limited).
Ava: Synthetic is good for most customers; live-ephemeral requires admin consent + audit entry.
Priya: Live TTL max = 3600s, enforced server-side with autos-delete and audit of lifecycle.
Dmitri: Block embeddings and attachments in previews. Embeddings could leak semantics.
Ava: Also disallow binary blobs in preview and show pseudonymized identifiers using tenant HMAC (never exposed).
Priya: UX: show projected_cost_delta, sample_rate diff, and a reversible undo. Add an "accept" button and an explanatory note about preview types.
Dmitri: Ramp behavior: staged increases (e.g., 0.001 -> 0.01 -> 0.05) with auto-pause if piirisk_rate spikes.
Ava: Runtime should emit piirisk_score per sampled item; if aggregate > threshold, abort ramp and alert oncall.
Priya: Add quota guard: check tenant token budget not global. Warn and suggest lowering rate or increasing quota.
Dmitri: Implementation: attach small JSON sampling policy to route config. Example proto in channel.
Ava: Legal: need explicit checkbox in audit: "I confirm live preview followed redaction rules" and user stored.
Legal-Bot: Logged. Also require retention policy for audit entries and tamper-evident hash.
Priya: Ops: add server-side rate limit for preview creations (prevent abuse).
ops-bot: Rule added: console-preview-rate-limit (FAIL beyond configured N/min).
Dmitri: Infra: ensure sampling applied at ingress before any persistence. Previews must not let raw bodies reach long-term stores.
Ava: Suggest defaulting to synthetic previews and only show live-ephemeral when tenant explicitly opts in and passes compliance checks.
Priya: Next steps: 1) infra spike for TTL + ephemeral store (Dmitri); 2) runtime: pii scoring + redaction pipeline in preview path (Dmitri); 3) UI: nudge, preflight, preview UI (Ava); 4) legal/help copy & audit checkbox (Priya).
Ava: I'll prototype the synthetic preview generator and UI mocks.
Dmitri: I'll start the infra spike and policy enforcement.
Priya: I'll write a short design doc and include cost projection example.
Legal-Bot: Please attach the compliance checklist to the design doc.
Priya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
